1. Why does orky-beb-2541 deploy but its verify_url 404? Route/domain not bound, OR the verify_url points at a path the worker doesn't serve (its routes are /pulse, /status/:site, /health — is verify probing / or /health?). Check which.
2. If route-binding: apply the runbook fix — bind via CF API workers/domains, confirm /health 200 before reporting done (deploy.mjs behaviour).
3. If verify-url-path: point the verifier at /health (the always-200 route), not root.
4. Re-verify 2541 → green. THAT is 'loop PRODUCES' cleared.

This is the whole game now — one worker, deployed, just needs its URL to answer. Land it. Then 2540's Telegram ping rides the same fixed path to Alex's phone. Report: 2541 green y/n.**
